user.title: Building
user.description: Rooms are taken from your Home Assistant areas. Pick the building settings first.

data_description.building_type: Selects the EN 16798-1 occupancy schedule and defaults.
data_description.target_category: EN 16798-1 category the rooms should meet. II is the normal expectation for new or renovated buildings; I for sensitive occupants.
data_description.window_days: Rolling period used for compliance, scores and categories.
data_description.scan_interval: How often history is read and rooms are re-assessed.
